findings.desc: type-safety: shared.ts:72 `return value as TokenDimension` is an unsound cast — the return type declares TokenDimension (number|null) but can be any malformed value (string, float, negative, NaN). This silences the TS type checker on an unsafe path and creates a contract lie that callers cannot detect statically. Prefer `return value as unknown as TokenDimension` (explicit double-cast) or introduce an internal RawTokenDimension type so the unsoundness is visible at every call site.
